channel.title: BayCounty.me updates
channel.description: New pages, data and corrections on BayCounty.me

item.title: Address lookup understands more ways of typing an address
item.guid: 2026-10-21-Address lookup understands more ways of typing an address
item.description: My Address now finds addresses typed with full street types (Drive, Avenue, Boulevard), directions (North, West), highway forms (Hwy 98, US 98, County Road 2321), Saint or St., spelled-out numbers (Tenth Street), MLK, unit numbers, and a city, state and ZIP on the end. If a street type is wrong, it shows the closest matches.

item.title: Votes: filters and corrections
item.description: Filter recorded votes by government, member, year and outcome, sort by date, amount or closest margin, and share a filtered view by link. Corrections checked against the original minutes: removed two Lynn Haven votes counted twice from a second copy of the same minutes; fixed member votes on a Lynn Haven CRA vote and a Panama City Beach vote that had been misread; restored amounts cut off or misread from scanned pages; and noted fiscal-year and resolution-number typos that appear in the minutes themselves.

item.title: Clearer vote summaries
item.description: Every recorded vote now has a plain-English headline and summary saying what was decided, rewritten from the motion in the minutes. The earlier text was pasted from the minutes and was often hard to read. Each card shows who voted which way and links to the minutes.

item.title: Correction: flood zones on My Address
item.description: Flood zones now come live from FEMA's National Flood Hazard Layer, which reflects Bay County's October 24, 2024 flood maps. The earlier lookup used an older county copy that missed high-risk zones for some addresses (about 8% in a sample of 300) and showed outdated base flood elevations. Results now also show the FIRM panel and any map revision, with a link to check the address on FEMA's map. Thanks to the readers who reported it.

item.title: Link previews
item.description: Every page now shows a title, summary and image with its headline number when a link is shared in a text, email or social post.

item.title: Send a correction from the site
item.description: A contact form on the About page sends corrections, records and questions straight to the BayCounty.me team. Email is optional and only used to reply.

item.title: Correction: Lynn Haven commission, and a cleaner officials page
item.guid: 2026-10-21-Correction: Lynn Haven commission, and a cleaner officials page
item.description: Corey Langford is listed as Lynn Haven's fifth commissioner; Judy Tinder's recorded votes remain on the votes page as a former member. The officials page now shows each board as a simple roster, with notes under names and county officers as cards. Springfield and Parker are described as clerk-run cities with no manager, and Parker's City Clerk, Rachelle Stanley, is listed.

item.title: How they voted
item.description: Recorded votes on budgets, tax rates, contracts, land and borrowing, with every member's vote and split votes first. Now covers the County Commission and every city: 351 votes, 115 of them split.

item.title: Contracts and vendors
item.description: Major contracts approved by Bay County and its cities since October 2022: winners, how they were awarded, change orders, emergency purchases, the bidding rules, and who the county actually paid the most.

item.title: Fees, utility bills and who runs Bay County
item.guid: 2026-10-20-Fees, utility bills and who runs Bay County
item.description: Every flat fee on Bay County tax bills, a typical monthly water, sewer and garbage bill in each city, and a guide to every elected seat, appointed manager and top salary. My Address now shows the actual fees on each parcel.

item.title: Designed PDF reports, and a new home page
item.guid: 2026-10-20-Designed PDF reports, and a new home page
item.description: Export PDF now builds a formatted report on every page, with tables, charts, maps and source links. The home page shows headline numbers and every topic.

item.title: Tourist tax and sales tax projects
item.description: The 5% bed tax: ten years of collections, how the pennies are split and what Visit Panama City Beach spends. Plus a map of 1,062 half-cent sales tax projects with their status, and the school half-cent.

item.title: Debt and audit findings
item.description: What every Bay County government owes, including big single payments ahead, and three years of audit findings in plain English, from audits filed with the Florida Auditor General.

item.title: Search, and Hurricane Michael recovery money
item.description: New: search across every page and record. New page tracking FEMA, HUD and state Hurricane Michael money in Bay County, with all 765 FEMA projects.

item.title: My Address
item.description: Look up any Bay County address for a tax estimate, representatives, schools, flood and evacuation zones, and CRA status. Uses the 2026 property roll.

item.title: Amendment 3, and the homestead exemption fix
item.description: New Amendment 3 page with the state's estimates for every Bay County government. Calculators now use the inflation-adjusted second homestead exemption ($25,722 for FY2026 bills).

item.title: Tax dollars and the plain-English guide
item.description: How your tax dollars are allocated: bill calculator, six years of rates and levies, and every government's budget. Plus a glossary and tap-to-explain terms across the site.

item.title: CRA Spending launched
item.description: Map and ledger of Bay County's six Community Redevelopment Agencies.
